$schema_note: Machine-readable production pipelines for video-orchestrator. Each pipeline is a staged manifest the orchestrator walks for 'make a whole video from a topic' requests (source.type == 'none' and the intent is a full production, not a single clip). Every stage produces one inspectable file in the job dir. Scaffold a run with tools/scaffold_pipeline.py.

common_stages.success: every non-obvious claim has a source; an angle is chosen

common_stages.produces: logline, audience, tone, length, platform, success metric
common_stages.success: human approves the proposal before any asset spend
script reads in the target duration at ~150 wpm
passes the slideshow-risk pre-gate (soft: WARN requires human confirm)

common_stages.produces: asset manifest: which shots are generated / b-roll / footage / image, with provenance + license
common_stages.success: every shot has a resolved asset + logged license; budget within cap

common_stages.produces: edit decisions / EDL, music + SFX cues, captions
common_stages.success: timeline assembled; music bed + transitions placed

common_stages.produces: final render via the matched engine + post-render QA
common_stages.success: run-qa.py overall PASS/WARN; render profile applied

explainer.description: Research-grounded educational video: a claim or how-to explained with narration + supporting visuals (b-roll, data-viz, title cards used sparingly).
explainer.notes: Lean on broll-retrieval + hyperframes data cards. Watch typography_overreliance - an explainer drifts into title-card slideshow fastest.

documentary-montage.description: Thematic montage cut from real archive / stock footage (Archive.org, NASA, Wikimedia, Pexels) over a narration track. Retrieval-first: the footage IS the video.
documentary-montage.notes: assets stage is dominated by broll-retrieval. Provenance/license logging in broll-manifest.json is mandatory. Stills need Ken Burns.

assets.produces: broll-manifest.json: per-shot clip + license + page_url from broll-retrieval
assets.success: every shot has a real clip with a logged free license

cinematic.description: Mood-driven generated piece (trailer / brand film / hero reveal) built from fal-seedance / veo3 shots with a music bed. Multi-clip consistency via Lock Block.
cinematic.notes: Metered generation - budget governance (free-first default) and the Lock Block from brand/consistency-rules.md both apply. Pair with kmboards video-style-* skills for the prompt bodies.

script.produces: beat sheet + shot prompts (one Lock Block reused across shots)
script.success: Lock Block is byte-identical across every multi-clip prompt
